review:
A Le game built around Golden Squares. When a win hits, the squares behind it turn gold; a Neon Rainbow switches them on to reveal Coins, Clovers, Treasure Pots or Jackpot Markers – then switches them on again to repeat it.

Clovers boost nearby or all coins, Treasure Pots store every coin and pot value, and Jackpot Markers each carry one of four jackpots, combining when several activate. Hacksaw doesn't publish RTP, volatility or max win outside the game – check the info screen. Le Bandit plus jackpots.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Hacksaw Gaming doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
